verbose.description: Verbosity level: 0 (normal/weird packets only), 1 (all except pings), 2 (include pings), 3 (hex dump)

no_resolve.description: Avoid name queries, use IP addresses only

no_ports.description: Avoid port number to service name decoding

show_interface.description: Show the interface IP that received the packet

syslog.description: Fork and use syslog facility to record events
